subject: Mek a nem fo hissef
body:
Gambit told me he was finally gonna make a name for himself, or at least I think thats what he said, it came out like “mek a nem fo hissef, chere” and I just nodded along like an Abraham Lincoln bobblehead from the Minneapolis airport. Finally you can do the same. Poor guy waited like a decade for his solo movie and then Disney bought Fox and he ended up in the Void with me. Anyway whatever you throw gets charged and goes boom, and an empty hand throws a card. have fun giving mobs paper cuts

-Poolbear
